cues.en: Hey, it's Bruno here.
cues.zh: 嗨，我是 Bruno。

cues.en: Hey, listen.
cues.zh: 嘿，聽我說。

cues.en: Thanks a lot for saving our behinds with that dog breed model.
cues.zh: 真謝謝你用那個狗品種模型救了我們。

cues.en: The clients are super happy.
cues.zh: 客戶非常滿意。

cues.en: And I know you worked hard this weekend instead of taking a break, so the CEO wants to actually speak with you.
cues.zh: 我知道你這個週末努力工作，沒有休息，所以執行長想跟你談談。

cues.en: He told me that he is really impressed by your level of work and he wants to learn more about machine learning and some of the projects that you've been working on.
cues.zh: 他說你的工作表現讓他印象深刻，他想多了解機器學習，以及你一直在做的一些專案。

cues.en: Now, he's not an expert in machine learning, but he's a really smart guy.
cues.zh: 他不是機器學習專家，但他很聰明。

cues.en: So, you know, hopefully you're able to make a good impression because this might lead to you getting a promotion.
cues.zh: 所以希望你能留下好印象，因為這可能讓你獲得升遷。

cues.en: He's also the one that hired me, so make sure you don't disappoint him.
cues.zh: 他也是當初聘用我的人，所以務必別讓他失望。

cues.en: I told him you're a great person to talk to about machine learning.
cues.zh: 我告訴他，要談機器學習，找你最合適。

cues.en: All right, we'll chat soon.
cues.zh: 好，我們很快再聊。

cues.en: Bye.
cues.zh: 再見。

cues.en: Got more meetings to attend.
cues.zh: 我還有其他會要開。

cues.en: All right, everybody.
cues.zh: 好了，各位。

cues.en: We're back at it again.
cues.zh: 我們又回來了。

cues.en: We're about to talk to the CEO of Keiko Corp..
cues.zh: 接下來要跟 Keiko Corp. 的執行長談話。

cues.en: But here's the thing.
cues.zh: 但問題來了。

cues.en: One of the skills that is really hard to find or a skill that is hard to excel at, especially for engineers,
cues.zh: 有一種技能很難找到具備的人，也很難精通，尤其對工程師、

cues.en: programmers and developers, is the ability to communicate with non technical people.
cues.zh: 程式設計師和開發人員來說，那就是與非技術人員溝通的能力。

cues.en: You see, in our day to day, we'll meet a lot of smart engineers, we'll meet a lot of people, a lot of coworkers that we can learn from.
cues.zh: 我們每天會遇到許多聰明的工程師，也會遇到許多值得學習的同事。

cues.en: But it's very hard to find people that are really smart when it comes to programming, when it comes
cues.zh: 但很難找到在程式設計、

cues.en: to machine learning, data science or any technical topic, but also able to communicate with managers, with coworkers, with bosses their findings.
cues.zh: 機器學習、資料科學或任何技術領域很厲害，同時也能把發現傳達給主管、同事和老闆的人。

cues.en: Good communication skill is one of those things that makes you stand out.
cues.zh: 良好的溝通能力，是讓你脫穎而出的因素之一。

cues.en: People get promoted not necessarily because of their technical knowledge, but because of their ability to communicate with others, to work with others, to be empathetic to those around them.
cues.zh: 人們獲得升遷，不一定是因為技術知識，而是因為能與他人溝通、合作，並體諒周遭的人。

cues.en: But in this section, we're going to learn about storytelling and communication, an important skill that most courses overlook.
cues.zh: 這一節要學習說故事與溝通，這是多數課程忽略的重要技能。

cues.en: It's easy to say that, Oh, no, it's it's fine.
cues.zh: 我們很容易就說，喔，沒關係。

cues.en: I'll let my work speak for itself.
cues.zh: 讓我的成果自己說話就好。

cues.en: But we live in a world where communication comes a long way.
cues.zh: 但在我們生活的世界裡，溝通能發揮很大的作用。

cues.en: And if you're able to master communication and storytelling, you will stand out.
cues.zh: 只要能掌握溝通與說故事，你就能脫穎而出。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。
